docstring:
Summary: This code fragment defines a header guard for the `browser_list.h` file in the Chromium project, preventing multiple inclusions.  
Parameters: N/A  
Returns: N/A  
Logic: The header guard is implemented using `#ifndef`, `#define`, and `#endif` preprocessor directives to ensure that the contents of the file are only included once during compilation. The `#pragma once` directive serves a similar purpose, providing a modern alternative to traditional header guards. The inclusion of the `chrome/browser/ui/browser_list.h` file indicates that this header may depend on or extend functionality related to browser lists in the UI. The comment suggests that this file is temporary and should be removed once all relevant includes have been updated, indicating ongoing maintenance and refactoring efforts within the codebase.
